status: PROPOSAL (W2 PCB-SB2): board-side contract of the PACK_FUSE carrier; not generated by mechanical/build.py
why: mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json has no PACK_FUSE entry (mechanical/params/boards.json small_boards PACK_FUSE names only the layout envelopes pack_fuse and pack_fuse_board). pcb/board_gen.py and pcb/check_boards.py read the contract named in pcb/boards/PACK_FUSE.json, so this file stands in until the mechanical lineage adopts the entry into mechanical/params/boards.json (then the spec points there and the board is re-routed once with [pcb-route PACK_FUSE]).
frame: board mm, origin = enclosure (161.7, 11.5), axes parallel to the enclosure x/y, y up; the board top (KiCad F, holder and pads) faces +z (the front wall), the bottom faces the plate front face z 40.5 across the 6.0 mm standoffs

sources.place: mechanical/params/mechanical.json layout pack_fuse_board [161.7, 11.5, 46.5, 10.7, 26.4, 3.5] and pack_fuse [163.7, 16.7, 48.1, 6.7, 16.0, 16.17] (W2 MECH-5 review, on wip/w2-int b0203649)
sources.standoffs: mechanical.json module_mounts pack_fuse standoffs [[169.0, 14.1], [169.0, 35.3]], fastener pem_so_m25_6; mechanical/generated/fastener-stacks.json PACK-FUSE (F39): under-head window 4.1-9.6 mm
sources.holder: Keystone 3568 (mechanical/params/parts.json keystone_3568: body .630 x .265 [16.00 x 6.73], .290 [7.37] above the board, holes .390 x .134 [9.9 x 3.40] dia .063 [1.60], Keystone catalogue p.48 https://www.keyelco.com/userAssets/file/K75p48.pdf read by W2 MECH-4 2026-11-07); land pattern KiCad 10.0.7 Fuse:Fuseholder_Blade_Mini_Keystone_3568 (graph F101; pins 9.92 x 3.4, drill 1.78)
sources.neighbours: battery tray 0.5 to the left (x 161.2), S40 riser x 174, plate boss PM4 (168, 7.5, D7) 0.5 below the bottom end, blower 0.6 above the top end; the case NTC TH302 (layout ntc_case [165.0, 24.0, 40.5, 4.0, 2.2, 2.2]) lies 3.8 under the board between the standoffs (W2 MECH-6)

stackup.fab: JLC 2-layer FR-4 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer copper (standard; decision 'Малі плати II: шари й мідь (W2 PCB-SB2)', build/15)

PACK_FUSE.name: PACK_FUSE carrier of F101: Keystone 3568 MINI fuse holder (Littelfuse MINI 297 7.5 A) and the 18 AWG solder-wire pads J116 (from BT104.+) and J117 (to S05)
PACK_FUSE.outline_note: = mechanical/params/mechanical.json layout pack_fuse_board box [161.7, 11.5, 46.5, 10.7, 26.4, 3.5] (W2 MECH-5 review): x 0-10.7 is enclosure x 161.7-172.4, y 0-26.4 is enclosure y 11.5-37.9
PACK_FUSE.holes_note: enclosure (169.0, 14.1) and (169.0, 35.3) = M-07 PF1-PF2, the PEM SO-M2.5-6ZI standoffs of mechanical.json module_mounts pack_fuse ('two holes 2.6 from the carrier board ends'); screws M2.5 x 6 ISO 14580 from the carrier top (build/17 F39, AI-PACK-FUSE-FIX)
PACK_FUSE.hole_keepout_note: no copper within 2.5 of the hole axis on both layers: the ISO 14580 M2.5 head dk 4.5 (CNC Kitchen TC-S-M2,5x6, 3djake page read 2026-11-11) on the top face and the standoff barrel C 4.20 (PEM SO-M2.5-6ZI, snapshot web:pem-so-m2-5-6zi) under the board are chassis potential (the Al plate) while the pours are the battery positive; the hole-to-holder distance is 2.6 (MECH-5: heads 0.35 clear of the 16.0 Keystone body), so 2.5 is the largest keepout radius that keeps the holder body out of it
PACK_FUSE.max_component_height_note: mechanical.json layout pack_fuse (Keystone 3568 body 7.37 + MINI fuse body 8.8 above the board top z 48.1, to z 64.27, 3.3 under the front wall); outside the holder column the board envelope pack_fuse_board ends at z 50.0, i.e. 1.9 above the board (spec height_zones)
PACK_FUSE.mount: 2x M2.5 x 6 ISO 14580 A2 TX8 into the PEM SO-M2.5-6ZI standoffs PF1-PF2 on the plate extension (build/17 F39)

edge_zones.use: 18 AWG from BT104.+ (pack positive) onto J116
S05-02 18 AWG from J117 to J105.2 (PWR)
